title: Sensex jumps 905 points to 74,151 as the Fed's pause, softer oil and Adani results lift the market
short: Sensex jumps 905 pts, Nifty back near 22,937 after Fed pause
dek: A two-day losing streak ended as the US Fed held rates, Brent eased and Adani Group results sparked buying. FMCG, realty and banks led; autos were the only sector in the red.
card: Nifty +237.90 at 22,936.75, Sensex +905.01 at 74,151.04. Adani Ports +6.29%, Kotak Bank +4.32%; Equitas SFB slumped after its CEO quit.
